entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of those (winds) which are sent consecutively.
Then (by) those (winds) that push with strength.
Then by those (winds) which lift and carry (the clouds).
Then (by) the ones (i.e. the verses of the Qur'aan) which clearly differentiate right from wrong.
Then, by the oath of those (i.e. the groups of angels) who instil the remembrance (of Allah) into the hearts.
To complete the argument or to warn (the disbelievers)
Indeed, what you are promised (i.e. resurrection, punishment and the Day of Judgement) will definitely occur.
Then (it will occur) when the light of the stars is put out.
And when the sky is split apart.
And when the mountains are made into dust and blown away.
And when the time of the Messengers (to be assembled) arrives.
'For which day were they (i.e. the distressing events) postponed?'
(They are postponed) for the Day of decision.
And what do you know what the Day of decision is?
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
Did We not destroy the earlier people?
We shall then drive the latter ones after them.
This is how We deal with the criminals.
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
Did We not create you from an insignificant fluid?
We then kept it in a safe place (i.e. the womb).
Until a known extent (i.e. until the time of birth).
Then We measured, so how excellent We are in having Power (over everything).
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
Did We not make the earth a gathering place?
For your living and dead?
And We placed high (mountains as) anchors therein and gave you excellent sweet water to drink.
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
'Walk towards that (i.e. the punishment) which you used to belie.'
'Walk towards the shadow of the smoke which has three branches.'
'Which neither gives (the coolness of a) shade nor saves from the flame.'
Indeed, Hell shoots up sparks like high palaces.
As if they are camels of yellow colour.
Woe for the beliers on that Day.
This is a Day in which they will not be able to speak.
Nor will they be given permission to present excuses.
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
This is the Day of decision; We have gathered you and all of the former ones.
If you have any plot now, so (try to) use it against Me.
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
Indeed, the pious are in shades and springs.
And amongst fruits; whichever they may desire.
(They will be told) 'Eat and drink with pleasure; the reward of your deeds.'
Indeed, this is how We reward the righteous.
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
'(O beliers!) Eat and enjoy for a few days, you are definitely criminals.'
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
And when it is said to them, 'Offer Salah,' they do not offer.
Woe to the beliers on that Day.
So, then after this (i.e. the Qur'aan), in which statement will they believe?
